correctness.rationale: For m≥2, d=m−1, substituting n=1 into exact Edholm–Mathew Theorem 1.3 gives L(j)=1,kappa(j)=j, hence Q_{m,1}(s)=Σ_{k=0}^{2d}a_k s^k with a_k=1+(d+3)k for 0≤k<d, a_d=d²+4d+1, and a_{2d−k}=a_k. Independent coefficient derivation checked the five numerator contributions against Fourier coefficients of d+(d+2)F_d+F_{d+1}, including endpoints and middle, for arbitrary d. Their equality establishes ζ^{−d}Q(ζ)=d+(d+2)|Σ_{j<d}ζ^j|²+|Σ_{j≤d}ζ^j|²>d on the unit circle (consecutive geometric sums cannot both vanish). Reciprocity, a_0=a_{2d}=1 and no unit roots yield exactly d inner and d outer roots. Explicit z,w∈H_m realize each inner s=t root while denominator nonzero. Fresh independent direct five-term integer coefficient script verified d=1..100 as a cross-check; infinite proof is symbolic.
residual_risks: All slopes in theorem have denominator n=1; general rational slopes, root simplicity, other diagonal branches not claimed.
